title: Annotation Save/Restore
description: Implement annotation persistence: save all page annotations to an independent JSON+ISF file, and restore them when reopening the same PDF.
action: Create AnnotationFileService that serializes/deserializes annotations. File format: JSON wrapper with PDF file hash + per-page ISF (Ink Serialization Format) as base64. Save triggered by Ctrl+S or menu File>Save Annotations. On PDF open, auto-check for matching .annotations file in same directory. Restore strokes to corresponding InkCanvas instances.

criteria: Source contains SHA256 or hash computation for PDF file
XAML contains menu item 'Save Annotations' or keyboard shortcut Ctrl+S
convergence.verification: dotnet build && manual test: draw annotations, save, close, reopen same PDF, verify annotations restored
convergence.definition_of_done: Annotations persist across sessions. Save creates .annotations JSON file. Opening a PDF auto-loads matching annotations if file exists.

files.change: Class with Version (int), PdfHash (string, SHA256), Pages (Dictionary<int, string> where value is base64 ISF)
SaveAnnotations(string pdfPath, Dictionary<int, StrokeCollection> pageStrokes), LoadAnnotations(string pdfPath) -> Dictionary<int, StrokeCollection>, ComputePdfHash(string path)
Add SaveCommand (Ctrl+S), auto-load annotations in LoadPdf(), collect strokes from all InkCanvas instances for save
Add File > Save Annotations (Ctrl+S) menu item

implementation: Create AnnotationFile model: { version: 1, pdf_hash: string, pages: Dictionary<int, string> }
Implement ComputePdfHash: SHA256 of first 1MB of PDF file (fast, sufficient for identity)

Implement SaveAnnotations: for each page with strokes, serialize StrokeCollection to MemoryStream using ISF format (stroke.Save(stream)), convert to base64, store in pages dict. Serialize AnnotationFile to JSON. Write to {pdfPath}.annotations
Implement LoadAnnotations: read JSON from {pdfPath}.annotations, verify pdf_hash matches (warn if mismatch), deserialize each page's base64 ISF back to StrokeCollection
Add SaveCommand to MainViewModel bound to Ctrl+S: collect all InkCanvas strokes by page index, call AnnotationFileService.SaveAnnotations
In LoadPdf(): after rendering pages, call AnnotationFileService.LoadAnnotations, apply returned StrokeCollections to corresponding InkCanvas instances
Add menu item File > Save Annotations with InputGestureText='Ctrl+S'

integration: Draw on pages 1,3,5 → save → close → reopen → verify strokes on correct pages
Open PDF without annotations file → no error
Modify PDF → warn about hash mismatch
success_metrics: Only pages with strokes are stored

rationale.chosen_approach: ISF is WPF's native ink format — compact, preserves all stroke properties (color, width, pressure). JSON wrapper adds metadata and human-readability.
decision_factors: Per-page storage is sparse (only annotated pages)
rationale.tradeoffs: Base64 ISF in JSON is ~33% larger than raw binary, but keeps the file format simple and inspectable

risks: StrokeCollection serialization API differences across .NET versions
Large annotation files if many pages annotated heavily
